items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: And no way, Jose. You know, there was just no way.

ctx.x: They just used to use an advertiser.

Yeah, somebody like that doing a commercial or jingle. Yeah, some of them. And it wasn't so much what they were anti as they would say, I'm going to use these guys. Nobody else. You know, I'd suggest singers and musicians because, you know, I was trying to be helpful. And no way, Jose. You know, there was just no way. And that was part, I think, still of that uptown bias. Right. Their clients wouldn't have it.
Yeah, we're sure oftentimes they brought the clients in the studio.
